label: Oct 30 completed: Tai Kwun/PMQ/escalators and Star Ferry/Temple Street/Mong Kok get minute-by-minute deep dives
notes: v19 (Milo, Oct 30, at Justin's direction): guide-2026-10-30.html gains the two deep dives it was missing, at the Dragon's Back standard. AFTERNOON: the escalator system as transport and subject (800 m, uphill all afternoon) → Tai Kwun (the Big Station's justice-in-one-compound story: Parade Ground, Barrack Block 1864, HQ Block 1919, up to Victoria Prison's cell halls, the mango tree, the JC aluminium ghosts) → PMQ (1951 married quarters to design incubator, with the Central School foundations underneath) → SoHo escalator drift → down Stone Slab Street to Pier 7. EVENING: the Star Ferry crossing (1888, upper deck) → Clock Tower + Avenue of Stars at blue hour → the 7 PM hold → A Symphony of Lights from the Clock Tower rail → Yau Ma Tei → claypot rice mechanics (soy on the rim, the faan jiu crust) at Four Seasons → Temple Street's fortune tellers at Yung Shue Tau → the Mong Kok graze (Ladies' Market, Sneaker Street, the snack canon) → the direct train home. No plan substance changed; the afternoon heading's leftover 'added Oct 29' tag was also removed.
